CO1: Explain what an .xlsx workbook file is, how openpyxl represents it as a workbook, sheets and cells, and which limits of the library and its documentation apply

CO3: Create, rename, add and remove sheets, write values, style fonts and save a workbook without overwriting the original
CO4: Set row heights, column widths, merges and freeze panes, write formulas, read their cached results with data_only, and build a chart from a Reference
